purpose: Source and literal measurement audit before admitting an alternative receptor panel; no prediction or performance evaluation
row_selection: Audit every source row; no selection by favorable outcome, receptor annotation or model result
measurement_handling: Preserve raw strings; distinguish nonnegative finite numeric values, explicit inequality bounds, missing fields and uninterpreted entries. Never replace missing/unknown/bounded values with zero or a binary infection label.
complementation: Keep original and complemented EOP as distinct contexts; blank complemented fields are unmeasured/unspecified, not failed rescue
crosswalk: Exact primary phage ID first; only unique exact complete-cell Alternative name or Full name matches may be reported as identifier correspondence; no guessed punctuation aliases or stock-identity inference
duplicate_handling: Record repeated phage/genotype rows with original row numbers; do not average, deduplicate or call independent replicates
target_context: Ando labels already known. Explicit T7/T3 name flags are overlap warnings, not sequence-homology clearance or predictions.
admission: No rows admitted to training, calibration or evaluation in this audit. Exact materials, assay reference/conditions, source figures, relatedness and model-specific inputs remain required.
